newsitem.title: BRAZIL: AGF Brazil unit to insure railway section.
newsitem.headline: AGF Brazil unit to insure railway section.

text.p: The Brazilian unit of Assurances Generales de France (AGF) said it had been awarded a contract to provide $90 million in insurance services to Brazil's Western railway, an AGF official said.
Under the one-year contract AGF unit will provide a $40 million insurance against property damages and business interruption. It will also provide a $50 million general liability insurance.

"It is the first time a private company provides insurance for a railway firm," said AGF's property insurance director Carlos Eduardo Almeida, noting that the Western grid section was privatized earlier this year.
Almeida said the firm will retain eight percent of the total risk, transferring the rest to the Brazilian Reinsurance Institute (IRB).
He said the insurance risk had been calculated based on historical accident records collected over the past five years.
The 1,620 kilometer (1,000 mile) Western grid, which is managed by the Noel Group, links the Southeastern state of Sao Paulo to the North of the country.
